Needs changes before merge.

The code checks passed. The required before/after screenshots are missing.

What looks good:

- Apply and Generate use the existing `EditOperationParams` command. The tests check undo and redo.
- The picker rejects fixture entities, non-finite positions, and tilted contours.
- The tests check the pick buttons, Clear actions, tab changes, and viewport markers.
- No golden files or snapshot PNGs changed.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream main `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f` was clean. That main commit is already in this head. I used `.claude/worktrees/review-2197` with its own build directory. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The table gives the results for each selected suite.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

| UI suite | Passed | Ignored | Failed |

| lib | 956 | 6 | 0 |

Safety checks:

These controls can change generated contour motion. I repeated two mutations from the PR body, one at a time.

1. I disabled the fixture guard in `start_exit_pick::take`. `clicking_a_fixture_while_picking_start_point_is_refused_by_name` failed. The assertion reported `a fixture click sets no start point`, with `Some(Point2)` instead of `None`.
2. I disabled the tilt guard in `start_exit_pick::take`. `tilted_contour_pick_is_refused_by_name` failed. The status reported an accepted start point instead of a tilt refusal.

I restored the source after the checks. `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib start_exit -- --test-threads=6` then passed all 13 tests. The worktree has no source changes. There were no moved goldens to compare.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_rows.rs:92` and `crates/ui/src/pick_ink.rs:59`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the Lead in / Lead out controls and the distinct start and exit markers. Issue #1473 item 2 also requires these images. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

Notes, not blocking:

- The PR adds lines to files that already exceed the 400-line guidance: `op_page.rs`, `interact.rs`, `state.rs`, and `egui_app/tests.rs`.
- I did not run the GUI, the release snapshot lane, or unrelated crate suites.
- The PR is mergeable. It remains a draft because the required visual evidence is missing.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing before/after screenshots for the Lead in / Lead out controls and distinct start/exit markers.

The PR body now links four screenshots showing the typed-only baseline, Pick/Clear controls, the start diamond, and the exit X-cross. They are stored only on the fork's images-only [pr-screenshots commit](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/tree/8ac7ae6de4a2800b3716f9d3aefbc01fbbd7d628/pr-2197). The body explains the offscreen capture method and seeded coordinates.

The evidence-link pin failed on the original body, passed with the images, failed when their links were removed, and passed after restoration. It checks all four remote PNGs. No source changes were needed. No screenshots, capture harness, logs, or evidence were committed to this PR branch.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Head remains `609b4f04d4c221a0dd76be523139207eabdf7366`. Plain push reported everything up to date. Please re-review the screenshot evidence on this unchanged head.

Addressed: the requested before/after screenshots for the Lead in / Lead out controls and distinct start/exit markers are linked in the PR body. I verified the four existing images on the fork's images-only pr-screenshots commit. The screenshot_evidence_links pin passes, fails when the links are removed from a local body copy, and passes after restoration.

Merged upstream/main to resolve the current conflicts. Both additions in op_page.rs are retained: pick-state handling and main's timing span. Added basis_version: 1 to the tilt-refusal test fixture for compatibility with main. The missing-field build was RED; tilted_contour_pick_is_refused_by_name now passes.

cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed all 17 steps. UI clippy passed with zero warnings. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed to this PR branch. No labels were changed. The PR remains a draft.

New head: 14dfc7980f48762b1e89e3e51cce6020e1e1da30. Please re-review.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier screenshot finding is resolved. I opened all four images linked from the PR body. They show the before/after controls, the start diamond, and the exit X-cross. The images stay on the fork's images-only branch. The PR contains no screenshot files.

What looks good:

- Viewport clicks change the parameter draft. Apply and Generate use the existing undoable command.
- The tests check command history, generated motion, Clear actions, tab changes, and markers.
- The picker refuses fixtures, non-finite positions, and tilted contours by name.
- No golden files or snapshot PNGs changed. There are no moved goldens to compare.

Local results:

I trial-merged the head with upstream main `9d17d594fadcad22eb65a1ae559a0b096a6b4865`. The merge was clean. All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2197`, with its own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ui`: selected the build and 16 UI suites. The final results are below.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

| UI suite | Passed | Ignored | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| lib | 1015 | 6 | 0 |
| boundary | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| boundary_picks | 6 | 0 | 0 |

| feedback | 7 | 0 | 0 |

| theme_files | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 | 0 |

The first library and machine runs failed because the test executables could not find the shipped assets. This machine placed the binaries under `target/debug/build/camcraft-ui/<hash>/out`. The asset resolver did not recognise that layout. For example:

```text
post refused: built-in post Fanuc: no posts folder found
```

I linked the worktree's assets beside the test binaries, inside target only. Both failed suites then passed in full. No tracked file changed for this adjustment.

Safety checks:

These controls can change generated contour motion. I repeated two mutations from the PR body, separately.

1. Disabled the fixture guard in `start_exit_pick::take`. `clicking_a_fixture_while_picking_start_point_is_refused_by_name` failed. It found `Some(Point2)` where the test required `None`.
2. Disabled the tilt guard in `start_exit_pick::take`. `tilted_contour_pick_is_refused_by_name` failed. The status reported an accepted point instead of a tilt refusal.

I restored the source. `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib start_exit -- --test-threads=6` passed all 13 tests. The source has no changes after restoration.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The PR adds lines to files that already exceed the 400-line guidance: `op_page.rs`, `interact.rs`, `state.rs`, and `egui_app/tests.rs`.
- I did not run the GUI, release snapshot tests, or unrelated crate suites.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
